Leah (CS): FYI Silverline preview (pilot) blocked by IdP cert rotation. PM says seat invites fail with 403. procurement breathing down their neck; AM flagged renewal as 'watch' if onboarding pauses >7 days.
Marcus (Enablement): propose a 20m 'pilot access' session: give them a scoped test key so product can validate core flows while certs get sorted.
Sam (SolutionsEng): 20m ok. i'll prep a short checklist: token scopes, audit notes, and a fallback revoke procedure. need their error log screenshot first.
Leah (CS): i'll ping the PM for screenshot and ask for ETA on cert rotation.
onboard-bot: Temporary pilot token created: https://redwood.example/tokens/silverline-temp-9 - expires 2024-10-01T00:00Z. Audit logging enabled.
Marcus (Enablement): i'll draft a 1-slide quickstart and add a 1-question pulse at session end: "Were your top-3 flows successful? yes/no" - capture result in CS notes.
Sam (SolutionsEng): recommend small-llm-efficient for staging to keep latency low. i'll also prepare rollback steps: revoke token -> recreate sandbox.
Leah (CS): onboard-bot, please create invite for Mon 2024-09-09 15:00 UTC  attendees: Leah (CS), Marcus (Enablement), Sam (SolutionsEng), Silverline PM.
onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: Mon 2024-09-09 15:00-15:20 UTC - "Silverline pilot: rapid access (20m)" - join: https://meet.redwood/example/slv123
Marcus (Enablement): next steps: 1) Marcus draft slide + pulse (Fri EOD). 2) Sam prepare checklist + rollback (Fri EOD). 3) Leah confirm log screenshot and forward.
Leah (CS): ack. i'll log as renewal-mitigation touch and CC AM once invite is accepted. :thumbsup:
